title: Sleepy whale
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#4a86d8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#2f5fa8'/>

  </defs>

  <ellipse cx='48' cy='58' rx='38' ry='26' fill='url(#whaleBody)'/>

  <path d='M 30 52 Q 35 57 40 52' fill='none' stroke='#d6ecff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M 30 34 Q 26 24 22 22 M 30 34 Q 32 22 34 18 M 30 34 Q 36 26 42 24' fill='none' stroke='#bfe0ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

</svg>
